title: ptx-deconfound: code, frozen splits, predictions and manuscript sources for a pre-registered evaluation of device shortcuts in pneumothorax detection
description: Code, pre-registration, frozen splits, per-image predictions for every model and seed (12 configurations, 54 runs), evaluation report and manuscript sources for the study 'Adversarial deconfounding with pseudo device labels does not remove the device shortcut in pneumothorax detection: a pre-registered, multi-seed external evaluation of twelve models'. Model weights are deposited separately. Source images are not redistributed; see README for dataset access.
